en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a fountain statue in a lush park or garden. The fountain features a young woman standing barefoot on a rocky pedestal, carrying a bucket beside a timber-like trough with water. Behind her is a column with sculpted details and what appears to be a bird on top. The foreground is landscaped with rocks and plants. Printed titles at the bottom identify the scene and the publisher with a date.
